name: Custom Shape Photo Frame
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Best Materials: All frames are handcrafted from 2 layers of 5mm wood. We hand select each piece of wood for its unique grain, knots and natural imperfections, which make it unique. Each frame is hand cut, sanded and stained. Frames will not peel, blister or separate from the wood like vinyl decals or paper coatings can.
  • Perfect Quality and Durability: Design is printed directly to the wood. It is totally SINGLE-SIDE printed in modern technology and is covered by superior copperplate paper painting, durable and vivid color. The entire sign is coated to protect against the sun, very sturdy for indoor or outdoor use, weather-resistant and fade-resistant. These frames are made with the highest quality materials and the utmost attention to detail, making them gifts to be treasured for many years to come.
  • Easy to Customize:Each Custom shape photo clip fame  is made to order and may vary slightly from our sample photo. We are more than happy to customize and personalize them any way you’d like!
  • Home decoration: The raised lettering creates an appealing 3D effect that adds depth and character to the piece. These frames are nice addition in your home, garden, swimming pool, etc…or any party decoration in special occasions. 
  • Gift of love: A perfect idea if you are finding a birthday gift, a housewarming gift, a festival gift, a Mother’s Day/ Father’s Day/ Christmas gift for your family or friends.
  • Easy to use: It can be used indoors or outdoors. Comes with a heavy-duty cardboard easel tached to the frame. You may add your own hardware for wall hanging if you wish but these are designed for tabletop display.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Photo Frame

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
